findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 619px of the width empty: div.mt-24.grid.
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 768px: "A free first conversation, and a reply w…" → 4 lines at 28px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: No visible button in the first phone screen.
findings.fix: On a phone the first screen still holds the headline, the supporting sentence and the action; move navigation into one row or a menu so it does not push them down.
